result.instructions: Tools for Streamtime, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which jobs are still open for our biggest client, and what is left to invoice?"; "How many hours did each user log last month, grouped by branch?"; "List the unpaid invoices older than 30 days with their companies.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Streamtime data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run streamtime_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run streamtime_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run streamtime_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. streamtime_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: streamtime_get_organisation
tools.title: Get organisation
tools.description: Get the Streamtime organisation this key belongs to: name, domain, currency and address. Good first call to confirm the connection. Public API: GET /organisation.

tools.name: streamtime_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List every user in the organisation with role, branch, job title, cost and billable rates. Public API: GET /users.

tools.name: streamtime_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: Get one user in the organisation by id. Public API: GET /users/{user_id}.

tools.name: streamtime_list_branches
tools.title: List branches
tools.description: List the branches (offices or teams) of the organisation. Public API: GET /branches.

tools.name: streamtime_list_rate_cards
tools.title: List rate cards
tools.description: List the rate cards that price time and items for the organisation. Public API: GET /rate_cards.

tools.name: streamtime_list_roles
tools.title: List roles
tools.description: List the roles that job item roles can use in the organisation. Public API: GET /roles.

tools.name: streamtime_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: Get one company (client) by id: status, lead user, rate card, tax number, phones, website and addresses. Public API: GET /companies/{company_id}.

tools.name: streamtime_list_company_contacts
tools.title: List company contacts
tools.description: List the contacts that belong to one company. Public API: GET /companies/{company_id}/contacts.

tools.name: streamtime_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id: name, email, phone, position, status and labels. Public API: GET /contacts/{contact_id}.

tools.name: streamtime_get_job
tools.title: Get job
tools.description: Get one job by id: company, status, dates, budget, and logged, invoiced and quoted totals. Public API: GET /jobs/{job_id}.

tools.name: streamtime_list_job_phases
tools.title: List job phases
tools.description: List the phases of one job. Public API: GET /jobs/{job_id}/job_phases.

tools.name: streamtime_list_job_items
tools.title: List job items
tools.description: List the items (tasks or line work) of one job, with status, dates and estimates. Public API: GET /jobs/{job_id}/job_items.

tools.name: streamtime_list_job_activity_entries
tools.title: List job activity
tools.description: List the activity feed of one job: comments and system entries. Optionally filter by activity entry type id. Public API: GET /jobs/{job_id}/activity_entries.

activity_entry_type_id.description: Only entries of this activity entry type id.

tools.name: streamtime_add_job_comment
tools.title: Add job comment
tools.description: Write a comment into the activity feed of one job. Visible to everyone with access to the job, and cannot be undone through this server. Public API: POST /jobs/{job_id}/activity_entries.

tools.name: streamtime_update_job_status
tools.title: Update job status
tools.description: Replace the status of one job with a status id (get the ids from streamtime_get_search_setup or the job record). The previous status is overwritten and the change is visible to everyone with access to the job. Public API: PUT /jobs/{job_id}/job_status.

job_status_id.description: The job status id to set.

tools.name: streamtime_get_quote
tools.title: Get quote
tools.description: Get one quote by id: status, approval, currency, totals and the job it belongs to. Public API: GET /quotes/{quote_id}.

tools.name: streamtime_list_quote_line_items
tools.title: List quote line items
tools.description: List the line items of one quote. Public API: GET /quotes/{quote_id}/quote_line_items.

tools.name: streamtime_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id: company, status, number, dates, currency, totals, balance and external accounting id. Public API: GET /invoices/{invoice_id}.

tools.name: streamtime_list_invoice_line_items
tools.title: List invoice line items
tools.description: List the line items of one invoice. Public API: GET /invoices/{invoice_id}/invoice_line_items.

tools.name: streamtime_list_invoice_payments
tools.title: List invoice payments
tools.description: List the payments and payouts recorded against one invoice. Public API: GET /invoices/{invoice_id}/invoice_payments.

tools.name: streamtime_get_logged_time
tools.title: Get logged time
tools.description: Get one logged time entry by id: user, job, date, minutes, cost and status. Public API: GET /logged_times/{logged_time_id}.

tools.name: streamtime_get_search_setup
tools.title: Get search setup
tools.description: Get the filters, additional data and sort columns for one search view. Call this first, then use the selectors in streamtime_search_records. Public API: GET /search/setup.

search_view.description: Search or report view name, from streamtime_get_search_setup or streamtime_get_report_setup (for example a jobs view).

tools.name: streamtime_search_records
tools.title: Search records
tools.description: Find individual records in one search view that match a filter string, such as job_status = "complete" and billable = "true". Use selectors from streamtime_get_search_setup. Returns one page, up to 1000 records. Public API: POST /search.

search_view.description: Search or report view name, from streamtime_get_search_setup or streamtime_get_report_setup (for example a jobs view).

query.description: Filter string, for example: job_status = "complete" and job_name contains "Project".

tools.name: streamtime_get_report_setup
tools.title: Get report setup
tools.description: Get the grouping options and statistics for one report view. Call this first, then use its names in streamtime_run_report. Public API: GET /report/setup.

search_view.description: Search or report view name, from streamtime_get_search_setup or streamtime_get_report_setup (for example a jobs view).

tools.name: streamtime_run_report
tools.title: Run report
tools.description: Get totals or grouped totals for one report view, such as the count and sum of invoices by company in a date range. Use names from streamtime_get_report_setup. Public API: POST /report.

search_view.description: Report view name, from streamtime_get_report_setup. Optional in the API.

column.description: Column to aggregate. Required for every mode except count.

statistics.description: The statistics to calculate for each group.

groupBy.description: Grouping column from streamtime_get_report_setup. Omit for one grand total.

dateField.description: Date column the start and end dates apply to.

query.description: Optional filter string, same syntax as streamtime_search_records.

time_breakdown.description: true = break the result down by time period.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Streamtime
prompts.description: What you can do with Streamtime here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_open_jobs_and_unpaid_invoices_for_a_client
prompts.title: Find open jobs and unpaid invoices for a client
prompts.description: Search the jobs view for open work from one client. Read an invoice and its payments to see what is still unpaid.

prompts.name: read_a_job_with_its_phases_items_and_activity
prompts.title: Read a job with its phases, items and activity
prompts.description: Open a job for its status, dates and totals. Read its phases, its items and its activity feed.

prompts.name: report_totals_by_group_for_a_date_range
prompts.title: Report totals by group for a date range
prompts.description: Read the report options of a view first. Then run the report to get totals, grouped as the view allows.

prompts.name: check_team_roles_and_billable_rates
prompts.title: Check team roles and billable rates
prompts.description: List the users with their roles, branches and billable rates. Compare them with the rate cards that price time and items.

prompts.name: post_a_comment_to_a_job_s_activity_feed
prompts.title: Post a comment to a job's activity feed
prompts.description: Read the activity feed of a job first. Then add a comment. The comment is visible to everyone with access to the job.

prompts.name: change_the_status_of_a_job
prompts.title: Change the status of a job
prompts.description: Read the job to find the status id you need. Then set the new status. The old status is overwritten.
